figures.finding: Cambodia's state support for film reported to UNESCO is in kind: administrative help and free import of filming equipment for foreign shoots (67 foreign projects in 2015), a short-film training programme and festival since 2017, and a 7-8 pm prime-time slot for Cambodian films on national television. No cash fund or rebate is named.
